methodology.purpose: Prevent Weeks 1-6 and Weeks 1-8 team styles from being attributed to an opening caller after an in-window handoff.
methodology.scope: Complete through Week 8 for the 2024 target season. This registry does not claim to enumerate changes after Week 8.
methodology.rule: Exclude the entire team-window when the replacement first called plays on or before the window end.

changes.reason: The Jets officially transferred play-calling from Nathaniel Hackett to Todd Downing before the Week 6 game, so neither Weeks 1-6 nor Weeks 1-8 is a clean opening-caller target.
The Browns officially transferred play-calling from Kevin Stefanski to Ken Dorsey for Week 8, so Weeks 1-8 is not a clean opening-caller target; Weeks 1-6 remains eligible.
